exposure: Women with at least one previous pregnancy loss
cohort: 1955 women with at least one previous pregnancy loss
finding: Several factors were associated with adverse reproductive outcomes in women with prior pregnancy loss, including older age, previous cesarean delivery, higher BMI, multiple previous pregnancy losses, and lack of pre-pregnancy intervention.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean delivery history was a risk factor for subsequent infertility (OR 2.46, 95% CI 1.27-4.76).
